# confine_path cases for test-confine.sh, run in its fixture tree: a.rs (a file), src/ (src/lib.rs,
# src/deep/x.rs), link (a symbolic link to a.rs), linkdir (to src), dangling (to nothing), out (to a
# directory outside the tree), fifo (a named pipe) and src/inner (a symbolic link to ../a.rs).
# One case per line: <want><TAB><path><TAB><status><TAB><stdout "CONFINE_REL CONFINE_TYPE", or the stderr line>.
# In a field: @EMPTY@ (a whole field) the empty path, @LONG:N@ N repetitions of "a", and @SOH@, @TAB@, @NL@,
# @ESC@ and @DEL@ the control characters 0x01, 0x09, 0x0a, 0x1b and 0x7f; both test-confine.sh and
# tools/auditor-tools/tests/confine_agrees.rs fill them in.
